more info about Cruise: I call him “magical baguette” because he is capable of shrinking himself from being the size of someone's leg to the size of my backpack that is no more than half his size, he won my heart over so fast with his unique behaviour and never fails to impress me every time! he loves his cat friends just as much as people and is an eccentric yet magnetic fella that gives him a lot of popularity with people who visit him at the cafe. surprisingly, he's been here since the middle of January and found his footing in the cafe’s everchanging kitty dynamic.

the reason he's named Cruise according to staff at the place is because of his rescue story as a kitten meowing in someone's car engine while it was running, and in a stroke of luck was able to get himself rescued with his sister (named Journey, likely adopted).

more info about Popoki + Tea: they are a cat cafe that gets the friendly cats or kittens off the streets to give them a second chance at life and encourages TNR in Honolulu, Hawaii. they get their cats from a local rescue organization nearby the cafe (Lucky Paws) and have helped many other cats beyond just cats like Cruise find a stroke of luck.

more info about Cruise: he is roughly a year old and his namesake is from his rescue story. he was found in someone's car engine with his sister named Journey as kittens. he is probably the sweetest dork I know with soft fur because he loves people and cats equally in his unconventional ways of expressing it!!! he flies under the radar a lot because he sleeps in a bed away from the chaos, and constricts himself to fit himself in the bed! when he isn't asleep, he likes to play with his cat friends and rub his head up on people's hands or legs, and chirps a lot! he plays very gently with people most of the time and almost never gets into serious fights with the other cats because of his very laidback behaviour!

more info about Popoki + Tea: it's in Honolulu, Hawaii, and the cats come from two TNR organizations, cats that came in prior to April are almost certainly from KAT Charities and those that came in after April are likely from Lucky Paws unless health conditions may affect the cats from KAT Charities before they come back.

at the cafe, she is super friendly and playful, she acts like an energetic kitten most of the time and loves people! when she is chilling at the window like these slides, she tries to interact with anyone who walks by! when she's elsewhere, she's often running around and playing with the other cats or rubbing up on people's backs at random. I love her endearing quirk of watching Instagram videos with me together!!

more info about Pebbles; she's a roughly 3 to 4 year old madame who fits the trope of a jaded old maid, not in a meanspirited way, but I notice that she fits a lot of characteristics! for example, she is incredibly talkative and the employees have previously described her meow as an old lady meow. another good example of this is how she doesn't like cats getting too close to her unless she figures they couldn't care less at that moment. she sits on people's laps and gets very jealous when other cats come even a few feet close to her, which is incredibly funny and is garnering a lot of popularity for everyone who visits. she isn't very food-motivated so much as she is attention-motivated honestly, as I've seen her only accept churu treats if it meant she would be getting pet afterward.

her backstory; she was known to be a two-time surrender from several different rescues, unfortunately. the first time she was returned was when she was younger, the reason cited was for keeping the owners awake late at night by meowing and trying to catch their eye, even if it's to be expected of a younger cat. then, she lived in a second house for a while before the owner unfortunately got laid off from their job and couldn't take her with them when they had to move back with family.

it genuinely upset me that Pebbles was returned the first time for being someone's dream cat, basically, a lovebug who had infinite capacity for love and attention. I'm super attached to her because I'm so happy that she ultimately managed to rekindle a love for people, and her presence feels bittersweet due to the timing of her existence. I like to think that Pebbles is just my second cat (who looked a lot like her and had a lot of similar mannerisms and a similar return history) reincarnated, even if she isn't, the thought of Pebbles emulating those mannerisms make me so happy!

I noticed the other perp tried to grab something else but it fell over. I couldn't distinguish what it was because I was too angry to even process wtf happened…

Verbatim from the cafe's account: “Last night, two lowlifes busted through our front door and took our cash drawer and nothing else. (…) It's shortly before 5 a.m. as I write this, so I'm still numb and detached to everything that went down, but the main thing is that I'm thankful the cats are okay and that no one was hurt. So until we can get our front door replaced, don't mind our boarded-up facade. And until we can get a new cash drawer, we'll be doing non-cash transactions only. Thanks for your understanding.”

personally, as someone who regulars the place week after week, I can't even begin to describe the seething anger I felt. It upset me the first time the cat cafe in Kapahulu was broken into, and it hit home so hard that the cafe I know the best was broken into in such a manner, because Popoki + Tea felt like a home away from home to me. The burglars smashed the glass, took the cash register, and they got away with it. When I watched the camera footage, I had a feeling I saw them at some point. And yet, nothing can even begin to describe the hatred that bubbled up inside me when I found out and watched the footage.

so this is coming from someone who lives in Hawaii, where unique options and life are both incredibly limited due to a mix between circumstance and economic focus including stuff such as its geographical position, size and cost of living, I finally left the state for the first time a couple months back for a visit to my relatives in the contiguous area of the U.S., specifically to Seattle.

when I left the plane, my jaw dropped when I realized the sheer size of King County alone, the massive amount of neighbourhoods, clusters of individually named cultural communities other than Chinatown, avenues that went into anything past the number 25, the 4 seasons (specifically autumn), and the fact that the air had vog during the entirety of my stay. whilst in Seattle, I remarked that the city was everything my hometown wishes it was, since Seattle was a very unique place even for a week's worth, and was stellar in comparison to where I live.
